games.name: Bubble Hockey
new: Move report (phone): turn it on in Feedback (or add ?log=1). It logs what your thumb did, what the game thought you meant and what happened. Tap Mark when a move didn't do what you wanted, then Email or COPY the report to Justin
Dead puck: if nobody's stick touches a loose puck for 5 seconds, the whistle blows and there's a faceoff at the nearest dot
Puck loses about 20% of its speed every time it bounces off the boards, posts or crossbar (shots off the stick are just as hard as before)
